info.title: QADeputy Universal API
info.description: QADeputy provides public API access to core QADeputy test management resources, including test runs, test suites, test cases, test results, users, products, and test case statuses.

post.description: Creates a test result for a QADeputy test case.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

testCaseId.description: Required QADeputy test_case_id receiving a test result.

testCaseStatus.description: QADeputy test case status ID/value for the result.

createdByUserId.description: QADeputy user ID creating the result.

testRun.description: QADeputy test run ID for the result.
